phase: Phase 1A — freeze the execution PACKET schema (the unit of module work). Design-only: NO packet is authored here.
spec_ref: SPEC §8 module partitions, §9 two-delta proof, §11 artifacts

module.note: A packet targets exactly ONE module.

management_question.note: Concrete management/business question the packet answers.

prerequisites.note: Other packet_ids / contracts that must be accepted first.

stop_conditions.note: inherited_canonical MUST reference fail-closed-stops.json; packet_specific adds packet-local stops.

two_delta_proof.note: evidence_delta = raw->normalized proof plan; meaning_delta = normalized->metric/grade/narrative proof plan. Both are FUTURE proofs planned here, executed later.

partitions_target.note: Exact, mutually exclusive; union == target_ids (or module expected set at module close).

invariants: 5 <= len(target_ids) <= 12, OR size_reason is present and nonempty.
target_ids are unique, all match ^SW-\d{3}$, and are all owned by `module` per the frozen 295->11 map.
partitions_target.{accepted_measured_ids,accepted_disposition_only_ids,rejected_ids} are pairwise disjoint and their union == set(target_ids).
stop_conditions.inherited_canonical references the canonical fail-closed stop list; a packet cannot silently drop a canonical stop.
two_delta_proof requires BOTH evidence_delta and meaning_delta (no single-delta acceptance).
a source failure among source_dependencies blocks only the dependent target_ids, never the whole module.
